Matthew 13:15 and Acts 28:27 both quote Isaiah 6:9-10, where God describes a people whose ears have become dull and heavy. This isn't physical deafness but a willful, hardened inability to truly hear and respond to God's word. The word suggests weight, burden, and the difficulty of perception when hearts resist truth."
